source.name: HNS: adidas unveils the new home and away jerseys of the Croatian national football team
source.quote: Today, adidas unveils the new official home and away jerseys of the Croatian National Football Team
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as belgium-2026-home). Croatia switched from Nike to adidas on 1 August 2026; HNS unveiled the new kits on 15 September 2026. Every placement checked in the launch images: HNS's announcement photos and Footy Headlines' studio gallery (footyheadlines.com, 2026-09-15: front, back, both sleeves, shorts and socks, model-worn and flat shots) show only the adidas logo and the HNS crest on the chest, Glagolitic script woven into the red checks, a Glagolitic 'Croatia' back-neck sign-off, tricolor collar and cuff trim, plain sleeves, and home shorts carrying only the HNS crest and adidas logo. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's first home shirt for Croatia (red-and-white checkerboard with Glagolitic script woven into the red checks, unveiled 2026-09-15 at the start of a new long-term partnership following the end of the 26-year Nike deal) carries only the adidas logo and the HNS crest; the launch photos show clean sleeves and plain shorts (HNS announcement and Footy Headlines' launch gallery).
